title: I built a vulnerable app and spent $1,500 seeing if LLMs could hack it
summary: A security researcher spent $1,500 building a deliberately vulnerable web application and tested multiple LLMs (including GPT-4 and others) to see if they could identify and exploit vulnerabilities, documenting the results and comparing LLM hacking capabilities.
problem_solved: Empirically measures whether current LLMs can autonomously discover and exploit security vulnerabilities in web applications.
why_valuable: Provides real-world data on LLM security capabilities and limitations, helping the security community understand AI-assisted attack vectors.
